newsitem.title: USA: Calif. energy grid operator names COO, acting CEO.
newsitem.headline: Calif. energy grid operator names COO, acting CEO.

text.p: California's Independent System Operator (ISO), which oversees the state's electrical transmission system, on Tuesday said Terry Winter would serve as its first chief operating officer.
In the first months of Winter's tenure, he will also assume the duties of acting chief executive officer, the ISO said in a statement.

Winter will oversee the integration of transmission systems from Edison International's Southern California Edison Co, PG&E Corp's Pacific Gas & Electric, Enova Corp's San Diego Gas and Electric and other utility systems which may join the ISO.
Once the operations are integrated, Winter's role will be to manage the state-wide energy grid.
Winter, formerly a division manager with San Diego Gas and Electric and an engineer with Arizona's Salt River Project, was selected followed a nationwide search, the ISO's board of governors said.
The board was created by the California legislature to oversee deregulation throughout the state. The board's selection committee is currently conducting a search for a permanent chief executive.
